body_markdown:
The RGC Foundation remains steadfast in its commitment to uplifting underserved communities, providing essential grants and resources to support elders in financial distress as well as children facing ADHD and ASD.


The driving force behind RGC’s mission stems from the personal journey of its Chairman & CEO. Having navigated severe learning disorders and speech difficulties during his youth, he persevered through academic struggles to ultimately graduate from UC Berkeley. His firsthand experience inspired RGC’s core commitment: bringing hope and healing through a natural, holistic Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) formula tailored for ADHD and ASD.


Continuing its pledge to community support, the RGC Foundation is proud to extend its aid to Salesian Youth Service. This strategic donation will directly benefit 12 schools, bolstering educational resources, mentorship programs, and youth development opportunities.


With this donation in youth services today, the RGC Foundation and Salesian Youth Service aim to empower young minds to overcome adversity, fulfill their academic potential, and build brighter futures.


To learn more about our ongoing initiatives or to contribute to life-changing grants, please visit https://www.rgcfoundation.org/donation.
